trivia: Throughout the Power Trip Story Arc, flashbacks consistently did not have the character's name identify them in their dialogue, leaving many characters in Agent X and Agent Z's pasts unnamed.
Both Agent 3 and Agent 8 use the same model phone, being in the shape of an octopus.
In the SpringFest 2026 re-run, agent z chose Team Li'l Bunnies, having chosen it previously in its original 2024 run.
The Splatoon 3 gameplay shown in 'Lost Phone' was recorded on the last instance of Eeltail Alley appearing in Anarchy Battles's rotations.
'Lost Phone' has the first instance of the wide internet meme 'Six Seven'. The scene was adjusted several times including the animations being scrapped for green screen depictions instead.
The footage in the Splatshort 'GameChat' took around 2.5 hours to get a game that matched the Splatshort's audio.
'Lost Phone' is the first Agent Z focused episode since 'The Perfect Present', 378 days prior.
The agent z Classic 'How Nintendo Expects You to Listen to Music', released in May 2023, was made outdated after the release of Nintendo Music in October 2024, 1 year and 5 months later.
'Lost Phone' reveals that Sheldon has a YouTube channel in-universe, dedicated to giving tutorials on anything and everything.

Bonus: flattered that you're interested enough to go looking in the code (:
